answer: A bond is refunded only after 36 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The quartz counter is kept in ember and ocean shows each reset. An copycat therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 36 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2572 identities would post 2672 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
